email_subject: Application - Trade Marketing & Category Management Intern
email_body:
Dear Barilla Team,

I am writing to apply for the Trade Marketing & Category Management Intern position in Brussels. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in data analysis, content creation, and project management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your brands and grow within a global company.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my analytical and organizational skills. I am proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, and I have experience with tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. My ability to take initiative and adapt quickly makes me confident in handling the diverse tasks of this internship, from market analysis to trade marketing execution.

I am particularly drawn to Barilla's values and the chance to work across multiple brands. My fluency in English and basic Dutch, combined with my eagerness to learn, would allow me to integrate quickly into your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Barilla.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Trade Marketing & Category Management Intern position at Barilla. As a junior digital marketer with a technical background and a passion for the food industry, I am eager to bring my analytical skills, creativity, and dedication to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed strong skills in data analysis, content creation, and project management. I regularly use Excel and PowerPoint to track performance and present insights, and I am comfortable with tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. My experience building and optimizing WordPress sites has taught me to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

I am particularly drawn to this internship because it offers a unique opportunity to work across all Barilla brands and gain hands-on experience in trade marketing and category management. I am confident that my ability to analyze data, create compelling content, and collaborate with diverse teams will allow me to contribute effectively to your projects, from monitoring media plans to executing in-store promotions.

I am a proactive learner, fluent in English, and have a basic knowledge of Dutch, which I am actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am willing to commute to Brussels. I am available to start in July 2026 and am excited about the prospect of growing within an international environment.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm align with Barilla's goals.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
